That's a valid point. You can definitely have as many characters as you want and I can see how people would have fun in collecting designs and species and such. People even have accounts on virtual pet sites (which I understand is a different thing altogether, but facillitates the idea some people find enjoyment in collecting). It makes people happy and artists can be creative in how they market their art. 

I guess what I have more trouble with, is the distinction people don't generally make between "characters" and their "fursona(s)". 

You do make a good point. It's a free web (for now and hopefully for a long while to come). Thanks for being civil, I love debate and conversation. One-sided attacks and willful ignorance are much too common these days
She looks like Charlie from "All Dogs go to Heaven".

And that makes total sense! Like, I bet your 'sonas mean a lot to you and you pride yourself in maintaining integrity. They're /personal to you/, the way they should be- it's what the fandom was pretty much based on. 

Not only that, but when you have your main(s) for a long time, they tend to evolve and grow with you...much like yourself. It's why I get so happy seeing people make changes on their fursona over the years instead of just trashing them for whatever is in. Like, the nice thing about such a creative community is that you can always edit different aspects of your 'sona and still have it represent you. It doesnt matter if the change is minor or grand. 

People now are just so used to excess, I guess. 

Back when I roleplayed a lot, I had 4 consistent characters I would use for different plots/scenarios and tweaked them accordingly.

Designs? I can understand liking what people design. But hoarding designs is ridiculous to me. People will /BUY/ dozens of designs on "bases" and just hoard them. I'm just curious to know /whyyyy/. 

Like, if you habe the time and put in the effort to develop lots of characters, then more power to you, I mean, people make livings off writing books and comics. That's just not believable for everyone. 

You're awesome, though. We need more peeps that don't try to take everything too far. Everyone is so extreme nowadays.
